events.verdict: Bitadze (ORL) brings his forearm forward as he moves alongside Adebayo's (MIA) path and marginal contact occurs during the drive.
Larsson (MIA) and Caldwell-Pope (ORL) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Caldwell-Pope (ORL) swipes down and initiates illegal contact with Rozier's (MIA) arm, which affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Larsson (MIA) extends his right hand forward and he dislodges Queen (ORL) as he retrieves the loose ball.
Herro (MIA) briefly clasps Bitadze's (ORL) arm in the post, but Bitadze is able to move through the marginal contact and continue his drive.
Adebayo (MIA) establishes screening position and is firming up in Caldwell-Pope's (ORL) path when marginal contact occurs to Caldwell-Pope's side as he moves around the pick.
Caldwell-Pope (ORL) swipes down and initiates contact with Smith's (MIA) arm during his upward shooting motion, which affects his play at the basket.
Larsson (MIA) steps towards Anthony's (ORL) path and he initiates illegal body contact that affects Anthony's driving shot attempt.
Anthony (ORL) establishes positive frontcourt position and legally goes into the backcourt to retrieve the loose ball after it is deflected by a defender.
Anthony (ORL) extends his arms forward and initiates body contact with Robinson (MIA) that affects his SQBR during the drive.
Robinson (MIA) extends his arm and initiates illegal head contact with Anthony (ORL) during the drive, affecting his SQBR.
Queen (ORL) cleanly blocks Herro's (MIA) shot attempt before the ball touches the backboard.
Robinson (MIA) reaches in and initiates illegal contact with Caldwell-Pope's (ORL) arm.
Isaac (ORL) makes clean contact with the ball and blocks Adebayo's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
